column2: Possible Fraud Indicators

Amount-Balance Mismatches
Transactions whose amount/balance do not match with previous transactions. Perfios might have added Dummy fillers for identification. And, for reports generated through non-online mode, an intermediate excel file is generated when there is running balance mismatch. This trigger notifies that there was manual intervention in adding/ deleting/ editing the transactions to generate report

Cash Deposit On Holidays
Cash Deposit transactions happening on holidays

Suspicious Salary Credits
Salary credits on bank holidays and round figure credits.

Suspicious bank eStatement
Suspicious bank eStatements are those statements having a Statement Status of "FRAUD" OR "REFER".

Atm Cash withdrawal
ATM withdrawals with cheque number or mode of payment is NEFT/RTGS

Behavioural/Transactional Indicators

Equal Credit Debit
Total amount of credit is exactly same as the total amount of debit, or total number of credit transactions is exactly same as the total number of debit transactions - both scenarios are extremely unlikely.

Negative EOD Balance
End of day bank balance on any day in an Savings account is unlikely to be negative.

Immediate big debit after Salary credit
Withdrawal of big amount of money soon after salary credit may be due to forged salary entries.

Cash deposit higher than maximum salary
Cash deposit transactions with amount greater than maximum salary

Irregular Salary Credits
Salary Credits which are not in all months within a narrow date range.

Rounded salary transaction
Salary transactions with rounded amount value

Round figure Tax Payments
Tax paid amounts are usually not round figures, such as multiple of 100.

More and frequent Cash Deposits than Salary
Higher number or amount of cash deposits than salary is an unlikely scenario.

No Transactions in the Expected Range
Months for which there are no transactions before 5th and after 20th.

Immediate cash withdrawals after cash deposit
Withdrawal of huge % of cash deposited within less amount of time

Only cash transactions
Maximum transactions involving cash deposit or withdrawals

EMI Cheque Bounce
Consecutive EMI Cheque bounce observed for the period

Suspicious Gaming Transactions
Unusual count and amount of gaming transactions
